<style id="v7140-avatar-frame-assets-css">
/* V7.145: real PNG avatar frames, thinner presentation + clipped head/shoulder previews. */
.v7137-frame-target{
  position:relative!important;
  isolation:isolate!important;
}
.v7137-frame-target[data-v7137-frame]{
  overflow:visible!important;
  outline:0!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
  --v7140-frame-glow:rgba(112,232,94,.55);
}
.v7137-frame-target>.v7139-frame-art{
  position:absolute!important;
  left:-21%!important;top:-21%!important;
  width:142%!important;height:142%!important;
  max-width:none!important;max-height:none!important;
  object-fit:fill!important;
  object-position:center!important;
  pointer-events:none!important;
  user-select:none!important;
  z-index:45!important;
  opacity:.985!important;
  transform:translateZ(0)!important;
  -webkit-transform:translateZ(0)!important;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 3px var(--v7140-frame-glow)) brightness(1)!important;
  animation:v7140FrameGlow 2.9s ease-in-out infinite!important;
  will-change:filter,opacity;
}
.v7137-frame-target[data-v7137-frame="ironwood"]{--v7140-frame-glow:rgba(118,194,86,.36)}
.v7137-frame-target[data-v7137-frame="silver_vine"]{--v7140-frame-glow:rgba(159,255,176,.48)}
.v7137-frame-target[data-v7137-frame="gold_crown"]{--v7140-frame-glow:rgba(255,205,82,.58)}
.v7137-frame-target[data-v7137-frame="emerald_aura"]{--v7140-frame-glow:rgba(79,255,102,.78)}
.v7137-frame-target[data-v7137-frame="emerald_aura"]>.v7139-frame-art{animation-duration:2.35s!important}
.v7137-frame-target[data-v7137-frame="haze_ring"]{--v7140-frame-glow:rgba(80,255,148,.68)}
.v7137-frame-target[data-v7137-frame="haze_ring"]>.v7139-frame-art{animation:v7140HazeGlow 3.8s ease-in-out infinite!important}
.v7137-frame-target[data-v7137-frame="resin_flame"]{--v7140-frame-glow:rgba(116,255,66,.86)}
.v7137-frame-target[data-v7137-frame="resin_flame"]>.v7139-frame-art{animation:v7140FlameGlow 1.65s ease-in-out infinite!important}
.v7137-frame-target[data-v7137-frame="referral_legend"]{--v7140-frame-glow:rgba(119,255,89,.62)}
.v7137-frame-target[data-v7137-frame="referral_legend"]>.v7139-frame-art{animation-duration:2.15s!important}
.v7137-frame-target[data-v7137-frame="prismatic_myth"]>.v7139-frame-art{
  animation:v7140PrismGlow 3.8s linear infinite!important;
}
@keyframes v7140FrameGlow{
  0%,100%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 2px var(--v7140-frame-glow)) brightness(.99)!important;opacity:.97}
  50%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px var(--v7140-frame-glow)) brightness(1.07)!important;opacity:1}
}
@keyframes v7140HazeGlow{
  0%,100%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(80,255,148,.42)) brightness(.98)!important;opacity:.95}
  45%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 11px rgba(106,255,177,.76)) brightness(1.07)!important;opacity:1}
  70%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(73,216,157,.58)) brightness(1.03)!important;opacity:.98}
}
@keyframes v7140FlameGlow{
  0%,100%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(116,255,66,.50)) brightness(1)!important}
  32%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(192,255,70,.92)) brightness(1.10)!important}
  68%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(91,255,67,.70)) brightness(1.04)!important}
}
@keyframes v7140PrismGlow{
  0%{filter:hue-rotate(0deg) saturate(1.06) drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(255,90,219,.66)) brightness(1.01)!important}
  33%{filter:hue-rotate(115deg) saturate(1.14) drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(82,231,255,.78)) brightness(1.08)!important}
  66%{filter:hue-rotate(235deg) saturate(1.16) drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255,222,80,.76)) brightness(1.07)!important}
  100%{filter:hue-rotate(360deg) saturate(1.06) drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(255,90,219,.66)) brightness(1.01)!important}
}
/* Own character page: larger overlay = visually thinner border and more avatar visible. */
#character #v510HeroRoot .avatar-scene.v7137-frame-target{
  overflow:visible!important;
  z-index:6!important;
}
#character #v510HeroRoot .avatar-scene.v7137-frame-target>.v7139-frame-art{
  left:-18%!important;top:-24%!important;width:136%!important;height:148%!important;
  object-fit:fill!important;z-index:70!important;
}
/* Shop/selector: avatar is clipped separately, so only head + shoulders remain inside the frame. */
.v7137-frame-preview{overflow:visible!important;position:relative!important}
.v7137-frame-preview>.v7140-preview-avatar-clip{
  position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;z-index:1!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;border-radius:inherit!important;background:#07100a!important;
  display:block!important;
}
.v7137-frame-preview>.v7140-preview-avatar-clip>.v7139-preview-avatar{
  position:absolute!important;z-index:1!important;
  left:-30%!important;top:-10%!important;width:160%!important;height:160%!important;
  max-width:none!important;max-height:none!important;
  object-fit:cover!important;object-position:center 12%!important;border-radius:0!important;
}
.v7137-frame-preview>.v7139-frame-art{
  left:-23%!important;top:-19%!important;width:146%!important;height:138%!important;z-index:8!important;
}
/* Hall of Haze + profiles: same art, slightly larger so the border reads slimmer. */
#hall .v646-row-avatar.v7137-frame-target,#v072OwnProfile .v646-own-avatar.v7137-frame-target,#v074ProfileContent .v652-profile-avatar.v7137-frame-target{overflow:visible!important}
#hall .v646-row-avatar.v7137-frame-target>.v7139-frame-art,#v072OwnProfile .v646-own-avatar.v7137-frame-target>.v7139-frame-art,#v074ProfileContent .v652-profile-avatar.v7137-frame-target>.v7139-frame-art{
  left:-25%!important;top:-25%!important;width:150%!important;height:150%!important;
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .v7137-frame-target>.v7139-frame-art{animation:none!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px var(--v7140-frame-glow))!important}
}
</style>

<style id="v7268-avatar-frame-layer-fix">
/*
   WICHTIG: Avatarbild und Rahmen sind zwei verschiedene Bildebenen.
   Der Charakter-Crop darf NIE auf .v7139-frame-art angewendet werden.
*/

/* Basis: das echte Charakterbild bleibt rund geclippt und identisch mit/ohne Rahmen. */
#world.active .v366-avatar{position:relative!important}
#world.active .v366-avatar > img:not(.v7139-frame-art){
  position:relative!important;
  z-index:1!important;
  width:100%!important;
  height:100%!important;
  max-width:none!important;
  max-height:none!important;
  object-fit:cover!important;
  object-position:center 22%!important;
  transform:scale(1.22)!important;
  transform-origin:center 24%!important;
  display:block!important;
  border-radius:50%!important;
  clip-path:circle(50% at 50% 50%)!important;
}

/* Ohne Rahmen darf der Container normal rund clippen. */
#world.active .v366-avatar:not(.v7137-frame-target[data-v7137-frame]){
  overflow:hidden!important;
}

/* Mit Rahmen: Container offen lassen, damit der Rahmen außen sichtbar bleibt. */
#world.active .v366-avatar.v7137-frame-target[data-v7137-frame]{
  overflow:visible!important;
  border-color:transparent!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
}

/* Rahmen-Bild explizit auf seine ursprüngliche Overlay-Geometrie zurücksetzen. */
#world.active .v366-avatar.v7137-frame-target[data-v7137-frame] > img.v7139-frame-art{
  position:absolute!important;
  left:-21%!important;
  top:-21%!important;
  width:142%!important;
  height:142%!important;
  max-width:none!important;
  max-height:none!important;
  object-fit:fill!important;
  object-position:center!important;
  border-radius:0!important;
  clip-path:none!important;
  transform:translateZ(0)!important;
  transform-origin:center!important;
  z-index:45!important;
  pointer-events:none!important;
}

/* Hall / Profil: ebenfalls nur das Charakterbild croppen, niemals den Rahmen. */
html body .app section#hall.v646-hall .v646-own-avatar > img:not(.v7139-frame-art),
html body .app section#hall.v646-hall .v646-row-avatar > img:not(.v7139-frame-art),
#v072OwnProfile .v646-own-avatar > img:not(.v7139-frame-art),
#v074ProfileContent .v652-profile-avatar > img:not(.v7139-frame-art){
  object-fit:cover!important;
  object-position:center 20%!important;
  transform:scale(1.13)!important;
  transform-origin:center 24%!important;
  border-radius:50%!important;
  clip-path:circle(50% at 50% 50%)!important;
}

html body .app section#hall.v646-hall .v646-own-avatar.v7137-frame-target,
html body .app section#hall.v646-hall .v646-row-avatar.v7137-frame-target,
#v072OwnProfile .v646-own-avatar.v7137-frame-target,
#v074ProfileContent .v652-profile-avatar.v7137-frame-target{
  overflow:visible!important;
}

/* Rahmen in Hall / Profil bleibt ebenfalls eigene Overlay-Ebene. */
html body .app section#hall.v646-hall .v646-own-avatar.v7137-frame-target > img.v7139-frame-art,
html body .app section#hall.v646-hall .v646-row-avatar.v7137-frame-target > img.v7139-frame-art,
#v072OwnProfile .v646-own-avatar.v7137-frame-target > img.v7139-frame-art,
#v074ProfileContent .v652-profile-avatar.v7137-frame-target > img.v7139-frame-art{
  position:absolute!important;
  left:-25%!important;
  top:-25%!important;
  width:150%!important;
  height:150%!important;
  max-width:none!important;
  max-height:none!important;
  object-fit:fill!important;
  object-position:center!important;
  border-radius:0!important;
  clip-path:none!important;
  transform:translateZ(0)!important;
  z-index:45!important;
  pointer-events:none!important;
}

@media(max-width:390px){
  #world.active .v366-avatar > img:not(.v7139-frame-art){
    object-position:center 22%!important;
    transform:scale(1.18)!important;
  }
  html body .app section#hall.v646-hall .v646-own-avatar > img:not(.v7139-frame-art),
  html body .app section#hall.v646-hall .v646-row-avatar > img:not(.v7139-frame-art),
  #v072OwnProfile .v646-own-avatar > img:not(.v7139-frame-art),
  #v074ProfileContent .v652-profile-avatar > img:not(.v7139-frame-art){
    object-position:center 20%!important;
    transform:scale(1.10)!important;
  }
}
</style>

<script id="v7230-server-frame-isolation">
(()=>{
'use strict';
if(window.__V7230_SERVER_FRAME_ISOLATION__)return;
window.__V7230_SERVER_FRAME_ISOLATION__=true;
const serverId=()=>String(window.v343CurrentServer||localStorage.getItem('growLegends:selectedServer')||localStorage.getItem('growLegends:server')||'beta');
const isServer1=()=>serverId()==='server1';
function stripVisibleFrame(){
  try{
    document.querySelectorAll('.v7137-frame-target').forEach(el=>{
      el.querySelectorAll(':scope > .v7139-frame-art').forEach(n=>n.remove());
      delete el.dataset.v7137Frame;
    });
  }catch(_){}
}
function arm(){
  if(!isServer1())return;
  document.documentElement.classList.add('v7230-frame-server-sync');
  try{window.__V7137_FRAME_STATE__=null}catch(_){}
  stripVisibleFrame();
}
let flight=null;
async function sync(){
  if(!isServer1())return false;
  arm();
  if(flight)return flight;
  flight=(async()=>{
    try{
      const r=await window.v7137FrameRefresh?.();
      const st=(r&&typeof r==='object')?r:window.__V7137_FRAME_STATE__;
      if(!st?.ok){stripVisibleFrame();return false}
      if(!st.active_frame_id)stripVisibleFrame();
      else try{window.v7137ApplyOwnFrames?.()}catch(_){}
      return true;
    }catch(e){
      stripVisibleFrame();
      console.warn('[V7.230] server frame sync',e);
      return false;
    }finally{
      document.documentElement.classList.remove('v7230-frame-server-sync');
      flight=null;
    }
  })();
  return flight;
}
arm();
window.addEventListener('growlegends:account-ready',()=>{if(isServer1())void sync()},{passive:true});
window.addEventListener('growlegends:first-playable',()=>{if(isServer1())void sync()},{passive:true});
window.addEventListener('pageshow',()=>{if(isServer1())setTimeout(()=>void sync(),120)},{passive:true});
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target instanceof Element?e.target.closest?.('[data-v343-server]'):null;if(!b)return;if(String(b.dataset.v343Server||'')==='server1')setTimeout(arm,0)},true);
[0,250,900,2200].forEach(ms=>setTimeout(()=>{if(isServer1())void sync()},ms));
window.v7230FrameDiagnostics=()=>({server:serverId(),syncing:!!flight,state:window.__V7137_FRAME_STATE__||null,guard:document.documentElement.classList.contains('v7230-frame-server-sync')});
})();
</script>
